macros.name: authorandplace
macros.doc: The \authorandplace{⟨author⟩}{⟨place⟩} inserts the name of the editor and the place where the news happened in the way many newspapers do.

macros.name: firstnews
macros.doc: The first two commands you can use inside the frontpage environment are \firstimage and \firstnews which include, respectively, the main image and the main heading in the front page.

macros.name: image
macros.doc: To include images within the text of a news, paperTEX provides an \image command.

macros.name: indexEntryFormat
macros.doc: \indexFormat sets the format of the title; \indexEntryFormat, the format of each index entry; \indexEntryPageTxt and \indexEntryPageFormat lets you define which is the text that goes with the page number (i.e. page, p., pág.) and its format.

macros.name: indexEntrySeparator
macros.doc: paperTEX creates a thin line between index entries, you can redefine it using \indexEntrySeparator.

macros.name: indexFormat
macros.doc: \indexFormat sets the format of the title; \indexEntryFormat, the format of each index entry; \indexEntryPageTxt and \indexEntryPageFormat lets you define which is the text that goes with the page number (i.e. page, p., pág.) and its format.

macros.name: minraggedcols
macros.doc: The \minraggedcols counter is used to tell paperTEX when news text should be ragged instead of justified.

macros.name: mylogo
macros.doc: The \mylogo macro can be redefined in order to use a customized head image.

macros.name: newssep
macros.doc: There are two commands you can use among the news inside paperTEX: \newssep and \newsection. The first one does not take any parameter and just draws a line between two news.

macros.name: raggedFormat
macros.doc: A new command called \raggedFormat is defined to control which kind of ragged format should be used.

macros.name: shortnewsitem
macros.doc: To add a piece of news inside the shortnews use the \shortnewsitem, indicating a title and the text of the issue.

macros.name: timestamp
macros.doc: \timestamp{⟨time⟩} which includes the time and a separator just before the text.

envs.name: indexblock
envs.doc: The indexblock environment contains a manually edited index of paperTEX. It takes one optional argument ⟨title⟩ that places a title over the index block.

envs.name: news
envs.doc: The main environment to include a piece of news is called news. It takes five arguments that set up the headings and structure of the news.

envs.name: shortnews
envs.doc: The shortnews environment creates a block of short news.

envs.name: weatherblock
envs.doc: the weatherblock lets you include a weather forecast. It takes one optional argument ⟨title⟩ that places a title over the weather block.
